        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start_daily</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_collect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_sortBusinessAreas</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_distribute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_registry" name="Registry">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_open</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_sortGroups</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_arm" name="Assistant Registry Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_qualityCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_compliant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_compileRequisitions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_sendRequisitions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_envelope</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_post</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_processed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_cashier" name="Cashier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_fees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_partyDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_printFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start_daily" name="Daily mail collection" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_collect" name="Collect mail from the party" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_sortBusinessAreas" name="Sort unopened mail into business areas" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_distribute" name="Distribute the mail" />

    <bpmn:task id="task_envelope" name="Put receipt and copied documents into an envelope" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_post" name="Post the envelope to the party" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_partyDetails" name="Capture party details" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_printFile" name="Print physical court file" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="gw_join" name="Join" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_processed" name="Mail processed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f01" sourceRef="start_daily" targetRef="task_collect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f02" sourceRef="task_collect" targetRef="task_sortBusinessAreas" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f03" sourceRef="task_sortBusinessAreas" targetRef="task_distribute" />
